senses.gloss: Dauḥśāsana^2, adj. (“belonging to Duḥśāsana”). § 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 83, †4242 (rudhiraṃ, drunk by Bhīmasena).

Dauḥśāsani, patron., the son of Duḥśāsana Dhārtarāshṭra. § 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 25, 1096 (fought with Śrutakīrti).--§ 593 (Abhimanyuvadhap.): VII, 33, 1472; 48, 1893, 1894; 49, 1935, 1938 (slew Abhimanyu); 51, 1988 (had slain Abhimanyu).--§ 596 (Pratijñāp.): VII, 73, 2577 (do.).--§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 5, 103 (had been slain by a son of Draupadī); 6, 160 (all. to § 593).-§ 615 (Gadāyuddhap.): IX, 64, 3615 (among the slain). --§ 620 (Śrāddhap.): XI, 26, 787 (his body is burnt; C. has ºnaṃ).--§ 785 (Anugītāp.): XIV, 61, 1825, 1828 (all. to § 593).
